business_objective: Review assignment-extension requests, apply approved due dates, and close each request after the student acknowledges the updated deadline.

stakeholder_statements.text: A student submits an assignment-extension request and identifies the course assignment, requested due date, and reason.
The instructor records the request as approved or declined and adds a reason when it is declined.
The coursework clerk updates the assignment due date only after the extension request is approved.
The student records acknowledgement of the updated due date.
The academic records officer closes the extension request only after student acknowledgement is recorded. Grading the assignment and changing course enrollment are outside this project.

business_objective: Prepare member-directory entries and publish them only after active membership and member approval are confirmed.

stakeholder_statements.text: A member submits a directory-entry request and identifies the membership and fields requested for display.
The membership clerk records whether the membership is active.
The directory curator prepares the entry using the fields requested for display.
The member records the prepared entry as approved or returned and adds a reason when it is returned.
The publication clerk publishes the directory entry only after active membership and member approval are recorded. Membership renewal and marketing communications are outside this project.

business_objective: Review project-dependency closure requests and close dependencies after deliverable completion, residual-impact review, and governance acceptance.

stakeholder_statements.text: A workstream lead submits a dependency-closure request and identifies the dependency, upstream owner, and affected milestone.
The dependency owner records whether the promised deliverable is complete and records supporting evidence. The evidence types and completion criteria have not been agreed.
The risk analyst records the residual impact as none, manageable, or blocking. The impact-assessment criteria are undecided.
The project governance chair records the closure as accepted or returned and adds a reason when it is returned. The acceptance criteria are not finalized.

The plan records clerk marks the dependency closed only after a complete deliverable, a non-blocking residual impact, and closure acceptance are recorded, then sends the outcome to the workstream lead. The delivery channel is undecided. Rescheduling milestones and changing project budgets are outside this project.

business_objective: Review corrections to the controlling source of a legal-case deadline and update accepted docket records.

stakeholder_statements.text: A paralegal submits a deadline-source correction and identifies the matter, current deadline source, and proposed deadline source.
The docket analyst records the proposed source document and source category. The accepted source categories have not been agreed.
The matter lawyer records the proposed source as controlling or not controlling. The controlling-source criteria are undecided.
The calendar reviewer records the correction as approved or returned and adds a reason when it is returned.

The docket records clerk replaces the current deadline source only after the proposed source is recorded as controlling and the correction is approved, then sends the outcome to the paralegal. The delivery channel is undecided. Providing legal advice and filing court documents are outside this project.

business_objective: Allocate limited preorder inventory among affected orders while preserving an unresolved conflict between reservation-time and payment-status priority.

stakeholder_statements.text: A customer support agent creates a preorder-allocation review and identifies the product release and affected orders.
The inventory planner records the available allocation quantity and reservation order for the affected orders. The method for grouping affected orders has not been agreed.
The commerce policy lead records an allocation-policy assessment. The lead says the oldest reservation must receive priority.
The payment operations reviewer records the payment status of each affected order. The reviewer says fully paid orders must receive priority even when an unpaid order was reserved earlier.

The allocation controller records each affected order as allocated or not allocated after the available quantity, reservation order, payment status, and allocation-policy assessment are present, then sends the outcome to the customer support agent. Nobody has decided which priority rule controls, who resolves equal-priority cases, which delivery channel to use, or the maximum allocation-decision time. Collecting payments and shipping allocated orders are outside this project; the meeting also drifted into complaints about the snack table.
